meta.title: A dormant PR blocks the create, names the PR and writes nothing
gaps: The dormant PR setup, including pr_dormant_threshold_days and a QA PR older than the threshold, is not expressible.
POST /event_groups with a line from the dormant PR is not covered by an operation or allowed request route.
POST /purchase_requests/unlock_dormant is not covered by an operation or allowed request route.
The expected dormant PR error response, including code 1125, the PR number, dormant_pr_ids, and verification that no event row was created, cannot be asserted.
The successful repeat create after unlocking cannot be automated.
